articles.title: Old Navy Coupon: How to Check the Offer Before You Pay
articles.description: A quick way to check an Old Navy coupon, sale page, and eligibility terms before checkout.
articles.answer: Start with Old Navy's official coupons page, match the promotion to your cart, and verify the end date or eligibility terms at checkout. Do not rely on a code copied from a third-party list unless Old Navy accepts it.

sections.heading: Start with the official Old Navy page
paragraphs: The official Old Navy coupons and promo codes page is the first place to check because it states the promotion and links back to the brand. TrueDealAtlas lists the source page next to each indexed offer so you can verify the terms yourself.
If a sale page and a coupon page show different wording, treat the more specific eligibility language as the rule for your cart.

sections.heading: Check the three details that change the outcome
paragraphs: Look for the expiration date, the products or categories included, and any membership, payment, or minimum-spend requirement. A headline discount is not proof that every item qualifies.
For sign-up or card offers, the official page may require a new account, a new card, or a first purchase. Those are different offers from a general sale price.

sections.heading: Use the checkout total as the final check
paragraphs: Add the eligible item, enter the code only when the official page provides one, and confirm that the discount appears before paying. If the discount does not appear, remove it from your decision rather than guessing at a replacement code.

faq.question: How do I get 20% off Old Navy?
faq.answer: Check the official Old Navy coupons page and its current eligibility terms. A percentage shown in a search result may be limited to a category, account type, or date window.

faq.question: Is there a 30% off code for Old Navy?
faq.answer: Only treat a 30% code as current when the official checkout accepts it under the terms shown by Old Navy. Third-party pages can retain expired or restricted codes.

faq.question: How can I get a $10 discount at Old Navy?
faq.answer: Review Old Navy's official sign-up and rewards information. The amount, qualifying order, and delivery method are part of the offer and should be confirmed on the brand page.

articles.title: Old Navy Coupon vs Sale Price: Which One Should You Check First?
articles.description: How to compare an Old Navy coupon with an advertised sale without assuming the discounts stack.
articles.answer: Check whether the item is already on sale, then read the coupon's exclusions and stacking rule. The checkout total, not the largest percentage in a headline, decides which option saves more.

sections.heading: Separate the sale from the coupon
paragraphs: A sale price is attached to an item or category. A coupon can have a code, an account requirement, or a minimum spend. Compare the final eligible price for the exact item rather than adding the percentages together.

sections.heading: Look for exclusions before comparing
paragraphs: Brand pages commonly restrict coupons by category, clearance status, payment method, or member status. Read the official terms before assuming a coupon applies to an item already marked down.

faq.question: Can Old Navy coupons stack with sale prices?
faq.answer: Only when the official terms allow it. Test the exact cart at checkout and use the result shown by Old Navy.

articles.title: Old Navy Promo Code: What Makes a Code Work or Fail
articles.description: A practical guide to Old Navy promo-code conditions, Super Cash thresholds, account rules, failed codes, and shipping eligibility.
articles.answer: An Old Navy promo code works only when the offer matches the cart, account, payment method, and redemption window. It can fail when the order falls below the qualifying merchandise threshold, when another offer is already applied, when the code is tied to a different account, or when the offer period has ended.

sections.heading: Super Cash thresholds and one-time use
paragraphs: A qualifying purchase of $25 or more earns one Super Cash coupon during an eligible earning period. A later purchase of $50-$99.99 can receive $20 off, $100-$149.99 can receive $40 off, and $150 or more can receive $60 off. Qualifying merchandise excludes shipping, handling, gift wrap, taxes, and gift cards.

Old Navy allows one Super Cash coupon in a single transaction, with a maximum discount of $60 per transaction. Separate available coupons may be used in separate eligible transactions while the redemption period is open. Super Cash cannot be redeemed with any other coupons or promotions. This means a promo code and Super Cash cannot be stacked in the same order.

sections.heading: Why an emailed code can fail
paragraphs: Since June 6, 2026, all customers can earn and redeem Super Cash; Encore membership is not required. Online shoppers may receive a code by email after a qualifying purchase, while Encore members also get account storage for earned codes and reward points. Email delivery does not prove that the current cart, product mix, or redemption window qualifies.

A support instruction to place the order first and request an adjustment is a service remedy, not proof that the code works at checkout. A store-level receipt adjustment is likewise not a replacement for a valid online redemption.

sections.heading: The $20, $40, and $60 bands
paragraphs: The $50-$99.99 band corresponds to $20 off, the $100-$149.99 band to $40 off, and $150 or more to $60 off. The $100 figure is the next band, not the minimum for every Super Cash redemption.

sections.heading: Shipping after discounts
paragraphs: Encore Core and Premier members have a published $50 shipping threshold, while eligible All-Access Cardmembers using the required card have a published $35 threshold. Online eligibility is measured after discounts and before taxes, and the shopper must be signed in.
A promo code can therefore remove free shipping without being invalid: the discount may lower the qualifying subtotal below the applicable threshold.

sections.heading: Checkout test
paragraphs: Confirm the channel, record the qualifying merchandise subtotal, check the account and payment requirement, apply one offer during its valid window, and read the final discount and shipping lines before payment.

faq.question: Why did my emailed Old Navy code fail?
faq.answer: Email delivery does not guarantee that the cart, account, product mix, or redemption window qualifies. Check the current terms and checkout response.

faq.question: Is $100 the minimum for $20 off?
faq.answer: No. The published bands place $50-$99.99 at $20 off, $100-$149.99 at $40 off, and $150 or more at $60 off.

faq.question: Can a discount remove free shipping?
faq.answer: Yes. The shipping threshold is measured after discounts and before taxes, so the qualifying subtotal can fall below the applicable tier.

articles.description: A four-state evidence check for separating an Old Navy coupon code from a sale, account offer, or card benefit.
articles.answer: Treat an Old Navy offer as a coupon code only when the official source exposes a code string and checkout accepts it for your cart. On the September 29 official-page snapshot, the sale wording was visible but no code string was captured, so it should be recorded as a promotion, not copied into a code field.

visual_steps.detail: Choose one of four offer types

visual_steps.label: Gate
visual_steps.detail: Require source, code, terms, and result

sections.heading: Use four evidence states
paragraphs: State 1 is an automatic sale: the price changes without a code. State 2 is a visible code: the official page provides a string to enter. State 3 is account-gated: signing in or joining a program is required. State 4 is payment-gated: a specific card or payment method is part of eligibility.
Do not collapse those states into one coupon claim. Record the state first, then record the discount wording and conditions exactly as Old Navy presents them.

sections.heading: What the official snapshot did and did not prove
paragraphs: The September 29, 2026 fetch of Old Navy's official sale page found "Fall Faves Up To 50% Off + Extra 30% Off Purchase." It proved that the wording appeared on the official source at the fetch time. It did not prove that every product qualified, that the offer stacked, or that a public code existed.

sections.heading: Diagnose a failed code in a fixed order
paragraphs: Check the date first, then the item category, minimum spend, signed-in account, payment method, and stacking rule. Keeping this order prevents repeated random code attempts from hiding the real eligibility failure.
Save the checkout message in your notes. "Expired," "not eligible," and "already applied" are different outcomes and should not be reported as the same failure.

sections.heading: The publish-or-reject rule
paragraphs: Publish a code only when its official source, exact string, applicable conditions, and checkout result can be recorded together. If any of those four fields is missing, publish the official promotion wording without a code or do not list the offer.

faq.question: Why does an Old Navy coupon code fail?
faq.answer: Check date, product category, minimum spend, account, payment method, and stacking rules in that order, then keep the exact checkout message.

faq.question: Is a sale banner a coupon code?
faq.answer: No. A banner can describe an automatic promotion. Call it a coupon code only when the official source provides a code string.

articles.title: Old Navy Discount Code: A Cart-First Verification Guide
articles.description: A reproducible cart worksheet for deciding whether an Old Navy discount code changes the delivered total.
articles.answer: A discount code counts as savings only when Old Navy's official terms support it and the same cart has a lower final total after the code. Compare one cart twice, record shipping separately, and reject any code that is absent from the official source or fails at checkout.

sections.heading: Build the baseline cart
paragraphs: Choose the exact item, size, color, quantity, account state, and delivery method. Record merchandise subtotal, automatic sale amount, shipping, and the pre-tax total before entering a code. The baseline is invalid if any of those inputs changes during the test.

sections.heading: Run one controlled code test
paragraphs: Enter one code from an official Old Navy source. Record the checkout response, the code discount line, any change to shipping, and the new pre-tax total. The measured savings are the baseline pre-tax total minus the tested pre-tax total; do not add a headline percentage to an already reduced price unless checkout actually does so.

sections.heading: Compare percentage savings with shipping
paragraphs: When only one code can be used, compare the dollar value removed by the percentage code with the shipping charge removed by a free-shipping offer. Use the same cart and delivery method for both tests. Choose the lower final total, not the larger-looking headline.

sections.heading: Apply the evidence boundary
paragraphs: The September 29 official sale-page snapshot showed "Fall Faves Up To 50% Off + Extra 30% Off Purchase" but exposed no code string in fetched text. That is enough to report the official promotion wording and not enough to invent or repeat a discount code.

faq.question: Are Old Navy discount codes the same as sale prices?
faq.answer: No. A sale can be automatic, while a discount code is entered and has separate terms. Compare the same cart before and after the code.

faq.question: Should I choose a percentage code or free shipping?
faq.answer: Test both on the same eligible cart when the terms allow only one. Choose the option with the lower final total.

articles.title: Old Navy Coupons In Store: What to Check Before You Go
articles.description: How to check whether an Old Navy coupon is usable in a store rather than only online, including the cross-channel Super Cash rule.
articles.answer: For an Old Navy store purchase, a coupon works when its terms allow in-store redemption, the redemption period is open, the merchandise qualifies, and the coupon is presented before payment. Super Cash has a documented store path; an online-only code does not become a store coupon merely because someone else used it. On a $100 qualifying merchandise purchase, an eligible Super Cash coupon belongs to the $40-off tier—not the $60-off tier.

sections.heading: Check the redemption channel
paragraphs: Look for language that says online, in store, app, or both. If a coupon needs a barcode, rewards account, or phone number, prepare that requirement before checkout rather than assuming a typed code will work.

Old Navy Super Cash has an explicit cross-channel rule: a coupon earned online or in a retail store can be redeemed in either place during an eligible redemption period. For an in-store purchase, the coupon must be presented at the time of purchase.

Do not generalize a third-party coupon listing to the register. Old Navy's published Super Cash rule is narrower and more useful: a coupon earned online or in a store can be redeemed in either channel during the eligible redemption period, but it must be presented at the time of an in-store purchase.

sections.heading: Bring the terms that matter
paragraphs: Verify the valid dates, minimum purchase, category exclusions, and whether the offer is limited to one transaction. Keep the official page available so the cashier or your account can show the same condition.

The store rule is not the same as an online adjustment promise. If an online code fails, keep the order receipt and the checkout response, but treat any later store or support remedy as case-specific rather than as a published redemption right.

sections.heading: A $100 cart does not explain a failed code
paragraphs: For a hypothetical $100 cart containing only qualifying merchandise, the published Super Cash bands put the purchase in the $40-off tier, leaving $60 before tax. The $60-off tier starts at $150. This is arithmetic from the published thresholds, not a checkout test. It identifies the tier; it does not diagnose why a specific code fails.

One shopper in August described an emailed code that failed even after support suggested two other codes: “They sent me a code in an email that doesn't work; person on chat told me to try SAVE and SUPER, neither of those work.” The published Super Cash terms set spending tiers, but they do not establish why that shopper's emailed code was rejected.

Another shopper in August said support proposed ordering first and requesting an adjustment afterward: “Mine isn't working either and the person on chat keeps telling me to place the order and then do an adjustment after.” That reported support path differs from the published in-store instruction to present the coupon at purchase; it is not a published promise that every order will receive a later adjustment.

A person describing their own store in August said staff had been told to address online Super Cash problems when customers brought an order receipt: “At my store we were told that there are issues with using super cash online. We were told to compensate people if they come in with the order receipt.” The official terms describe redemption channels and timing; they do not promise this receipt-based remedy at every store.

faq.question: Can I use an Old Navy online coupon in store?
faq.answer: Only when the official terms include in-store redemption. Confirm the channel and any barcode or account requirement before relying on it.

faq.question: Can I redeem Super Cash in store if I earned it online?
faq.answer: Yes. Old Navy says Super Cash earned online or in a store can be redeemed in either channel during an eligible redemption period. In a store, present the coupon at the time of purchase.

articles.title: Old Navy Promo Code Today: How to Check the Date
articles.description: A same-day checklist for checking whether an Old Navy promo code is still valid today.
articles.answer: Open Old Navy's official promotion page today, confirm the stated end time and eligibility, and test the code in checkout. A dated search result is not proof that the offer is still active.

sections.heading: Use the current official timestamp
paragraphs: Promotions can end at a stated date or after a limited window. Read the official page on the day you plan to order and note whether the terms use a time zone, a member window, or a first-order condition.

sections.heading: Confirm the result before paying
paragraphs: Apply the code to the eligible cart and make sure the discount is visible before payment. If the code fails or the terms have changed, remove it from the decision instead of guessing at a replacement.

faq.question: How do I know an Old Navy promo code works today?
faq.answer: Check the current official terms and confirm that checkout accepts the code for your exact cart today. Search snippets and old coupon pages can lag behind the live offer.

articles.title: Old Navy Promo: How to Compare the Current Ways to Save
articles.description: A source-first way to compare an Old Navy promo, sale price, sign-up offer, and rewards benefit.
articles.answer: Compare the official promo's final eligible price with any sale, sign-up, or rewards condition in the same cart. Choose the offer that Old Navy actually applies, not the one with the biggest headline.

sections.heading: Separate the saving mechanisms
paragraphs: An Old Navy promo may be a sale, a coupon code, a new-customer offer, a card benefit, or Super Cash. Each can have a different audience, date window, and exclusion list, so do not combine the labels as if they were one code.

sections.heading: Make one checkout comparison
paragraphs: Use the same item and quantity for each eligible option. Record the final total and the condition needed to receive it, then keep the offer that is both valid and practical for your order.

faq.question: What is the best Old Navy promo?
faq.answer: The best option is the current official offer that applies to your exact cart after its restrictions and any required account or payment condition are included.

sections.heading: Find out whether shipping is automatic
paragraphs: Some Old Navy shipping offers depend on order value, membership, a promotion window, or the delivery method. Read the official terms to see whether a code exists or whether the benefit appears automatically in checkout.

sections.heading: Check the order total and destination
paragraphs: Use the actual items and delivery address in checkout, then verify the shipping line before paying. A free-shipping headline may exclude oversized items, expedited delivery, or orders below the stated threshold.

faq.question: Do I need an Old Navy free shipping code?
faq.answer: Not always. Check the current official shipping terms and your checkout total; the offer may apply automatically when the order and account meet the requirements.

faq.question: How do you get free shipping at Old Navy?
faq.answer: Start from Old Navy's official promotion and shipping terms. Free shipping may apply automatically above the stated order threshold or for rewards members; confirm the shipping line in checkout before paying.

articles.title: Old Navy Super Cash: How Earning and Redemption Work
articles.description: The official Old Navy Super Cash thresholds, delivery methods, exclusions, and stacking rules in one source-checked guide.
articles.answer: During an eligible earn period, a qualifying merchandise purchase of $25 or more earns one universal Super Cash code. During a later eligible redeem period, the code is worth $20 off $50-$99.99, $40 off $100-$149.99, or $60 off $150 or more. Old Navy's public page did not display the current period dates when checked on October 7, 2026, so verify the active window before relying on a code.

visual_steps.label: Earn
visual_steps.detail: Spend $25+ in an eligible earn period

sections.heading: Separate the earn window from the redeem window
paragraphs: Super Cash is not an always-on discount. Old Navy describes an eligible earn period followed by a subsequent eligible redeem period. The public program page explained the thresholds but did not show the current start or end dates in its visible text on October 7, 2026, so those dates are unknown until Old Navy publishes them.
Treat the code as future value, not an immediate reduction to the purchase that earned it. Check the official page and your account for the active redeem window before planning a cart around it.

sections.heading: Know where the code arrives
paragraphs: Online shoppers receive a qualifying code by email within approximately 24 hours. In-store shoppers receive a paper coupon code at checkout. Encore members also have earned codes attached to their account.
A code earned online can be redeemed in a participating store, and a code earned in a participating store can be redeemed online, subject to the eligible period and program terms.

sections.heading: Apply the threshold to eligible merchandise
paragraphs: The earn and redeem thresholds exclude gift cards, packaging, shipping and handling, gift wrap, and taxes. Old Navy says merchandise sold and shipped by third parties may count toward a redemption threshold but does not receive a share of the discount.

Only one Super Cash coupon can be redeemed per transaction, up to $60. If the purchase is below the threshold needed for the coupon's full value, the applicable lower discount can be used and the unused potential value is forfeited.

sections.heading: Check stacking and membership separately
paragraphs: Super Cash cannot be combined with other coupons, promotions, or an employee discount. Encore members may redeem reward points in addition to Super Cash code savings.

Old Navy states that all customers have been eligible to earn and redeem Super Cash since June 6, 2026. Encore membership is no longer required, although members get account-based code tracking and reward-point benefits.

faq.question: What is Old Navy Super Cash?
faq.answer: It is a coupon program with separate earn and redeem periods. A qualifying $25-or-more merchandise purchase earns a code that can later provide a tiered discount when the redeem threshold is met.

faq.question: Can Old Navy Super Cash be combined with another coupon?
faq.answer: No. The official program page says Super Cash cannot be redeemed with other coupons or promotions, though Encore members may also redeem reward points.

faq.question: Do you need an Encore membership to earn Super Cash?
faq.answer: No. Old Navy says all customers can earn and redeem Super Cash as of June 6, 2026; membership adds code tracking and other member benefits.

articles.answer: Old Navy's Encore program has three levels: Core is free to join, Premier begins after $350 or more in annual spend, and All-Access is for Encore Cardmembers. The official page lists 5 points per $1 at the family of brands for Core and Premier members, while eligible cardmembers earn 25 points per $1 there when the card is the required payment type.

paragraphs: Core membership is free. Premier status is shown for members with $350 or more in annual spend. All-Access benefits require an Encore credit card, so card approval and payment terms are separate from free membership.

sections.heading: Match points to the payment method
paragraphs: The official comparison shows Core and Premier members earning 5 points per $1 at the family of brands. It shows eligible All-Access Cardmembers earning 25 points per $1 there, subject to the card and rewards terms.

sections.heading: Treat shipping and birthday benefits as conditional
paragraphs: The page lists free shipping thresholds by level and says members must be signed in. Birthday bonuses are for eligible members and designated family members, with the gift and additional conditions determined by Gap Inc.

faq.question: Is Old Navy Encore free?
faq.answer: Core membership is listed as free to join. Premier depends on annual spend, while All-Access requires an Encore credit card.

faq.question: How many points do Old Navy members earn?
faq.answer: The official page lists 5 points per $1 at the family of brands for Core and Premier members, with different cardmember earning terms for All-Access.

paragraphs: The official Encore page names a birthday bonus but does not publish a universal amount or code. A third-party claim about a fixed percentage is not enough to state that every member receives it.

sections.heading: Eligibility depends on the account
paragraphs: The official Encore comparison lists a birthday bonus for the Core member, for the Premier member and one family member, and for the All-Access member and up to three family members. These are the published tier descriptions, not a promise that every account receives the same gift.

Old Navy limits the benefit to eligible members and their designated family members. Gap Inc. chooses the gift and can apply additional conditions. Read the offer assigned to the account before treating it as an Old Navy coupon.

faq.question: Does Old Navy give a birthday discount?
faq.answer: Old Navy lists a birthday bonus for eligible Encore members, but the public page does not promise a fixed amount. Check the offer delivered to the eligible account.

faq.question: Can a family member receive an Old Navy birthday bonus?
faq.answer: The official membership table lists one designated family member for Premier and up to three for All-Access. The Core column lists the member's own bonus. Eligibility restrictions and the terms of the account offer still apply.

articles.description: Compare the official Encore free-shipping thresholds for Core, Premier, and All-Access members.
articles.answer: Old Navy's Encore page lists free basic or standard shipping on qualifying online orders of $50 or more for signed-in Core and Premier members. Eligible All-Access Cardmembers can receive free standard shipping on qualifying orders of $35 or more when using the required Gap Inc. or Encore credit card.

sections.heading: Identify the membership level first
paragraphs: Core, Premier, and All-Access do not have identical shipping terms. The threshold and shipping speed shown by Old Navy depend on the account level and, for All-Access, the eligible card payment.

sections.heading: Calculate the threshold after discounts
paragraphs: The official details say the qualifying online total is measured after discounts and before taxes. The order must ship to one U.S. address, including Puerto Rico, and choosing another shipping method may add charges.

faq.question: Do Old Navy members get free shipping?
faq.answer: Eligible signed-in members can receive free shipping when their order meets the threshold for their level. Confirm the shipping line before payment.

articles.title: Can You Stack Old Navy Super Cash With Coupons?
articles.description: The official stacking rule for Super Cash, other coupons, promotions, employee discounts, and Encore reward points.
articles.answer: Old Navy says Super Cash cannot be redeemed with another coupon, promotion, or employee discount. Encore members may redeem reward points in addition to Super Cash savings, which is a separate exception stated on the official program page.

sections.heading: Separate coupons from reward points
paragraphs: The official terms prohibit combining Super Cash with other coupons or promotions. They separately allow Encore members to redeem reward points alongside Super Cash code savings.

sections.heading: Use one Super Cash coupon per transaction
paragraphs: Old Navy limits redemption to one Super Cash coupon per transaction, up to $60. A shopper can redeem more coupons in separate eligible transactions, but unused value on a partially used coupon is forfeited.

faq.question: Can I use a promo code with Old Navy Super Cash?
faq.answer: No. The official page says Super Cash cannot be redeemed with other coupons or promotions.

faq.question: Can I use an employee discount with Old Navy Super Cash?
faq.answer: No. Old Navy's Super Cash terms exclude employee discounts alongside other coupons and promotions.

faq.question: Can I use Old Navy rewards points with Super Cash?
faq.answer: Yes, Old Navy states that Encore members may redeem reward points in addition to Super Cash code savings.

articles.answer: Old Navy's Encore page lists free Core membership separately from All-Access Cardmember benefits. The lower $35 free standard shipping threshold applies to eligible All-Access Cardmembers using the required card, not to every Encore member.

sections.heading: Do not confuse membership and card status
paragraphs: Core membership is free. The official Encore comparison distinguishes it from Premier, which is based on annual spend, and All-Access, which is for Cardmembers. A member-only benefit does not automatically require opening a credit card.

sections.heading: Check the card-dependent shipping benefit
paragraphs: The official comparison shows Core free basic shipping at $50 or more, Premier free standard shipping at $50 or more, and eligible All-Access Cardmembers free standard shipping at $35 or more with the required card. Sign in and check the post-discount, pre-tax qualifying total before payment.

faq.question: Does Old Navy have a credit card?
faq.answer: Old Navy's Encore page describes an All-Access Cardmember level and card-dependent benefits. Check the issuer's current terms before applying; a Core Encore account does not itself require a card.

sections.heading: Use the qualifying subtotal, not the original cart price

The $35 or more free standard shipping benefit is for eligible All-Access Cardmembers paying with the required card. The account must be signed in, and the order must ship to one qualifying U.S. or Puerto Rico address.

faq.question: Why did free shipping disappear after I applied a coupon?
faq.answer: The coupon may have lowered the qualifying post-discount, pre-tax amount below your tier's threshold. This is a possible explanation, not a diagnosis of your cart; confirm the actual shipping charge and official terms at checkout.

articles.title: Where to Find Old Navy Super Cash: Email, Receipt, or Account
articles.description: Trace an earned Super Cash code to its official delivery channel before trying to redeem it.
articles.answer: Old Navy says qualifying online purchases receive a Super Cash code by email in about 24 hours, in-store purchases receive a paper coupon at checkout, and Encore members can also find earned codes in their account. A code still needs an eligible redemption window and qualifying purchase.

sections.heading: Follow the purchase channel
paragraphs: For qualifying online purchases, Old Navy describes delivery of the universal code by email within approximately 24 hours. In a participating store, the paper coupon is provided at checkout. Encore members may also see earned codes saved in their account.

sections.heading: Finding a code is not the same as using it
paragraphs: The earn and redeem periods are distinct. Check the code's redemption dates and the official merchandise thresholds; do not assume a code found in email or an account is active today. The public program text reviewed for this guide did not establish a current redemption period.

faq.question: How long does Old Navy take to email Super Cash?
faq.answer: Old Navy's program page says qualifying online purchases receive the code by email within approximately 24 hours. If it is missing, check the purchase account and the official help channel rather than using an unverified third-party code.

articles.title: Old Navy Super Cash Returns: What Happens to the Discount?
articles.description: How Old Navy allocates Super Cash across eligible items and handles the discount when you return merchandise.
articles.answer: Old Navy allocates a Super Cash discount across the prices of eligible items in the transaction. If you return some or all of the merchandise bought with that coupon, the coupon’s dollar discount is not refunded or credited back. Check the item-level return details before deciding what to send back.

sections.heading: The discount follows eligible items in the transaction
paragraphs: Old Navy says the Super Cash discount is allocated across the purchase price of all eligible items in the transaction. Merchandise sold and shipped by third parties receives no portion of the discount, even though the terms say it may count toward a minimum purchase threshold.
That allocation matters when a transaction contains several eligible items: the coupon is not described as a discount attached only to the first item or to the item with the highest price.

sections.heading: A return does not restore the coupon value
paragraphs: The program terms say that if some or all merchandise bought with a Super Cash coupon is returned, the coupon’s dollar discount will not be refunded or credited back. The policy applies to partial returns as well as returns of the full purchase.

This is separate from the merchandise return itself. The cited Super Cash terms explain what happens to the coupon discount; they do not specify an individual item’s refund amount, return eligibility, or processing time. Check the order’s return details for those terms.

sections.heading: Check the order before submitting a return
paragraphs: Review which items were eligible for the discount and the return summary shown for those items. Do not count on a returned item restoring unused Super Cash or creating a new coupon credit: the published program terms say the discount is not returned as cash or credit.

faq.question: Do I get my Old Navy Super Cash back if I return an item?
faq.answer: Old Navy’s program terms say the Super Cash coupon discount is not refunded or credited back when some or all merchandise from that purchase is returned.

faq.question: How is Super Cash divided across an order?
faq.answer: The terms say the discount is allocated across the purchase price of all eligible items. Third-party merchandise sold and shipped by the seller does not receive a portion of the discount.

faq.question: Does the Super Cash return rule explain my merchandise refund amount?
faq.answer: No. The Super Cash terms describe whether the coupon discount is restored. They do not state your item-specific refund amount or return eligibility.
